name: Brand Identity
summary: Logo, colour, typography and brand guidelines for startups and tech companies, built to work in the product too.
seoTitle: Brand Identity Designer for Startups · Mihai Boboc
seoDescription: Brand identity design for startups and tech companies: logo, colour, typography, visual language and brand guidelines that carry across app, web and print.
headline: Brand identities that look as considered as the product.
intro:
A brand should make a product easier to recognise and easier to trust. I design identities for startups and tech companies that need to look as considered as what they build, and that hold together from the app icon to an event stand.

Because I also design products, the identity is built to work in an interface, not only on a business card: colours with enough contrast, type that reads at small sizes, and a system your team can actually use.

offers.title: Logo design
offers.text: A distinctive mark and wordmark, with versions for app icons, favicons, dark backgrounds and print.

offers.title: Colour & typography
offers.text: A palette and type system chosen for screens first, with the contrast and sizes an interface needs.

offers.title: Visual language
offers.text: Icons, imagery, graphic elements and motion that make every touchpoint feel like the same brand.

offers.title: Logo reveal
offers.text: A short animated reveal of the logo for the website, videos and social.

offers.title: Brand guidelines
offers.text: Clear rules and ready-to-use files, so your team and other designers can apply the brand on their own.

offers.title: Rollout
offers.text: Applying the identity to the website, app, social and print, so the launch looks consistent from day one.

process.title: Discover
process.text: Your business, your audience and the competition, and what the brand needs to say first.

process.title: Explore
process.text: A few clear directions, shown in real use: on a screen, a card, a sign.

process.title: Refine
process.text: One direction turned into the logo, colour, type and visual language.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: Guidelines and every file you need, plus help applying it where it matters most.

faq.title: What do I get at the end?
faq.text: Logo files for screen and print, the colour and type system, the visual elements and brand guidelines that explain how to use them.

faq.title: Can you design the website as well?
faq.text: Yes. For 7Code I designed the brand identity and the full website, and built the site with a CMS the team can update.

faq.title: Do you work on rebrands?
faq.text: Yes. A rebrand starts from what already works, so recognition isn’t lost on the way.

faq.title: How do we start?
faq.text: Tell me about your company and where the brand will be used. I’ll come back with questions and a suggested next step.

ctaText: Tell me about your company and I’ll get back to you with questions and a next step.
